title_en: Three People in a Hot-Air Balloon
grammar_focus: 复习 KS19/43/67 表示“能够/做成”的说法(收官包·干净课美语化):can / could(能力)、be able to(各时态的能力,尤其 was/were able to 表某次成功做到)、manage to(费劲设法做成)、can't / couldn't(不能),以及三者的辨析(某次成功做到用 was able to / managed to,不用 could)
scene: 去年夏天,三个朋友有幸坐上了一次热气球。“你们都挤得进吊篮吗?”飞行员问。“我们试试看!”他们说。不一会儿,他们就能俯瞰脚下整片山谷。可风很大,飞行员没法轻松掌舵。“别担心——我能应付,”他镇定地说。紧张了一分钟后,他设法让气球掉了头。他们谁都不曾从空中看过自己的镇子。“真不敢相信有这么美!”其中一个人说。最后,飞行员把气球安全地降落在一片田野里。他们经历了一生难忘的冒险——而且没有一个人受伤。

grammar_card.title: 复习 KS19/43/67 “能够/做成”的说法
grammar_card.intro: 本课复习几种表示“能够、做到”的说法:①can / could——表能力(They could see the whole valley);②be able to——同样表能力,但可用于各种时态,尤其 was/were able to 表“某一次成功做到”(The pilot was able to land safely);③manage to——“费了一番劲、设法做成”(He managed to turn the balloon around);④can't / couldn't——“不能、无法”(The pilot couldn't steer easily)。辨析要点:表“某一次具体成功做到了”,用 was able to 或 managed to,而不用 could;could 多用于“过去一贯具备的能力”。

rows: They could see the whole valley.
The pilot was able to land safely.
He managed to turn the balloon around.
某次成功做到 → was able to / managed to,不用 could。

specialRules.rule: 美语“度假”说 vacation(英式 holiday);“秋天”说 fall(英式 autumn)。本课已按美语写。
表“过去某一次费劲成功做到”,用 was able to 或 managed to,不用 could;could 用于“过去一贯的能力”。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — What did the three friends do last summer?

passage: Last summer, three friends were able to join a hot-air balloon ride. "Can you all fit in the basket?" the pilot asked. "We can try!" they said. Soon they could see the whole valley below them. But the wind was strong, and the pilot couldn't steer easily. "Don't worry — I can handle it," he said calmly. After a tense minute, he managed to turn the balloon around. None of them had ever been able to see their town from the sky before. "I can't believe how beautiful it is!" one of them said. Finally, the pilot was able to land the balloon safely in a field. They managed to have the adventure of a lifetime — and no one got hurt.
